import numpy as np

def unet_forward(x, weights, t):
    # Encoder
    x1 = np.maximum(x @ weights['enc1'] + weights['enc1_b'], 0)  # conv + ReLU
    x1_p = x1[::2, ::2]  # max pool
    x2 = np.maximum(x1_p @ weights['enc2'] + weights['enc2_b'], 0)
    x2_p = x2[::2, ::2]
    # Bottleneck
    b = np.maximum(x2_p @ weights['bottleneck'] + weights['bottleneck_b'], 0)
    # Decoder
    up2 = np.kron(b, np.ones((2, 2)))  # upsample
    up2 = np.concatenate([up2, x2], axis=-1)
    up2 = np.maximum(up2 @ weights['dec2'] + weights['dec2_b'], 0)
    up1 = np.kron(up2, np.ones((2, 2)))
    up1 = np.concatenate([up1, x1], axis=-1)
    output = up1 @ weights['out'] + weights['out_b']
    return output
